plain_description.what: Compares Mistral-Large and grok-4-1-fast as judges on the same 944 answer-key-decidable pairs, with the same recipe, using cached verdicts. No calls.
plain_description.why: It decides whether a judge about ten times cheaper can replace the expensive one for all future re-judging.
plain_description.information: Equal accuracy justifies the swap. A gap would mean paying for quality. Result: accuracy is a wash (0.865 vs 0.864) and the board is the same, so grok became the standard re-judge model. Caveat: grok later also entered as a contestant, and judge-to-same-family bias is untested. Later ruled 'history, not evidence'.
